import os,stat,hashlib,json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
project=Path('/srv/projects/pink-iptv')
base=project/'tests/device-proof'
root=Path('/srv/projects')
out={'scope':'PINK IPTV obsolete emulator disk cleanup','mode':'bounded destructive hygiene','status':'ABORTED','other_projects_touched':False}
def require(x,msg):
 if not x:raise RuntimeError(msg)
def active(name):return subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','is-active','--quiet',name],timeout=8).returncode==0
def space():v=os.statvfs(str(root));return v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize
try:
 require(os.geteuid()==0,'need root')
 require(project.is_dir() and not project.is_symlink() and base.is_dir() and not base.is_symlink(),'PINK root is missing or link')
 require(str(project.resolve())=='/srv/projects/pink-iptv','PINK root not canonical')
 before={s:active(s) for s in ('pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','nginx','ssh')}
 require(all(before.values()),'critical PINK/SSH service not healthy before cleaning')
 selected=[];apks=[]
 for curr,dirs,files in os.walk(base,followlinks=False):
  for name in files:
   f=Path(curr)
   p=f/name
   if name.endswith('.apk') and p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():apks.append(p)
   if p.suffix.lower() not in ('.qcow2','.img'):continue
   require(not p.is_symlink() and p.is_file(),'emulator disk is symlink/not file')
   require(p.resolve().is_relative_to(base.resolve()),'emulator disk escapes project')
   require(any(part.endswith('.avd') for part in p.relative_to(base).parts),'disk outside named Android emulator')
   st=p.stat()
   require(stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink==1,'disk has unexpected hard links')
   selected.append((p,st.st_size))
 require(len([p for p,s in selected if p.suffix=='.qcow2'])==6,'unverified count qcow2')
 require(len([p for p,s in selected if p.suffix=='.img'])==6,'unverified count img')
 disk_bytes=sum(z for _,z in selected)
 require(4_000_000_000<disk_bytes<5_100_000_000,'unexpected emulator disk total')
 before_apks={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in apks}
 require(len(apks)>=3,'PINK APK evidence unexpectedly missing')
 for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
  if not proc.name.isdecimal():continue
  try:
   comm=(proc/'comm').read_text().strip()
   require(comm not in ('qemu-system-x86_64','qemu-system-aarch64','emulator'),'emulator running')
   cwd=os.readlink(proc/'cwd')
   require(not cwd.startswith(str(base)),'process using PINK test directory')
   for fd in (proc/'fd').iterdir():
    try:link=os.readlink(fd)
    except OSError:continue
    require(not any(link==str(p) for p,z in selected),'emulator disk open by process')
  except (PermissionError,FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):pass
 free0=space()
 for p,_ in selected:p.unlink()
 remaining=sum(1 for p,_ in selected if p.exists())
 require(remaining==0,'emulator files still present')
 after={s:active(s) for s in before}
 require(after==before,'PINK systemd state changed during cleanup')
 require(all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hash for p,hash in [(Path(x),h) for x,h in before_apks.items()]),'PINK APK checksum changed')
 out.update(status='PASS',deleted_emulator_files=len(selected),deleted_allocated_logical_bytes=disk_bytes,free_before_bytes=free0,free_after_bytes=space(),freed_bytes=space()-free0,apk_files_preserved=len(apks),services_unchanged=True,github_untouched=True)
except Exception as e:out['error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:220]
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
